Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play · Body, health & movement · Conversation, family & daily routines

jump verb

also leap, jumping, jump down, jump out, jump across, spring up

classical

saliō, salīre, saluī, saltum

verb, fourth conjugation

jump or leap

Other words

  • saltus, saltūs m. — a jump or leap

    noun, fourth declension · classical

  • exsiliō, exsilīre — jump out or spring up

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical

  • dēsiliō, dēsilīre — jump down

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical

  • trānsiliō, trānsilīre — jump across

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical

Examples

  • Altius salī.

    Jump higher.composed

  • Ambōbus pedibus salī.

    Jump with both feet.composed

  • Iterum salī.

    Jump again.composed

  • Salī.

    Jump.composed

  • Theodōrus salit.

    Theo is jumping.composed
